declarations.name: GRWTSK.ProofHorizon.CorkscrewChamberCap.ArithmeticPickupSource.pickup_original_reset
declarations.type:
∀ {A t : ℝ},
  1 ≤ A →
    2 * Real.log A ≤ t →
      ArithmeticPickupSource.pickup t - ArithmeticPickupSource.pickup (2 * Real.log A) =
        2 * (A⁻¹ - Real.exp (-t / 2)) * ArithmeticPickupSource.mertens (A ^ 2) +
          2 *
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊A ^ 2⌋₊ ⌊Real.exp t⌋₊,
              ArithmeticPickupSource.moebiusCoefficient n * (↑n ^ (-(1 / 2)) - Real.exp (-t / 2))

declarations.type:
∀ (x : ℝ),

    2 * ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, ArithmeticPickupSource.moebiusCoefficient n * (↑n ^ (-(1 / 2)) - x ^ (-(1 / 2)))

declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Preorder α] [inst_1 : LocallyFiniteOrder α] {a b x : α}, (x ∈ Finset.Ioc a b) = (a < x ∧ x ≤ b)

declarations.type: ∀ {lower upper : ℝ}, 0 ≤ lower → 0 ≤ upper → ∀ (n : ℕ), n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊lower⌋₊ ⌊upper⌋₊ ↔ lower < ↑n ∧ ↑n ≤ upper

declarations.name: GRWTSK.ProofHorizon.CorkscrewChamberCap.ArithmeticPickupSource.zero_prefix_eq_mertens
declarations.type: ∀ (x : ℝ), ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, ArithmeticPickupSource.moebiusCoefficient n = ArithmeticPickupSource.mertens x

declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s : Finset α} {a b : α}, (a ∈ insert b s) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ s)

declarations.name: GRWTSK.ProofHorizon.CorkscrewChamberCap.ArithmeticPickupSource.pickup_eq_closed_finite_sum
declarations.type:

          ArithmeticPickupSource.moebiusCoefficient n * (↑n ^ (-(1 / 2)) - Real.exp (-T / 2))

declarations.type:

      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊upper⌋₊, f n = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊lower⌋₊, f n + ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊lower⌋₊ ⌊upper⌋₊, f n

declarations.name: GRWTSK.ProofHorizon.CorkscrewChamberCap.ArithmeticPickupSource.finite_pickup_reset
declarations.type:
∀ {lower upper : ℝ},
  1 ≤ lower →
    lower ≤ upper →
      ArithmeticPickupSource.finitePickupAt upper - ArithmeticPickupSource.finitePickupAt lower =
        2 * (lower ^ (-(1 / 2)) - upper ^ (-(1 / 2))) * ArithmeticPickupSource.mertens lower +
          2 *
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊lower⌋₊ ⌊upper⌋₊,
              ArithmeticPickupSource.moebiusCoefficient n * (↑n ^ (-(1 / 2)) - upper ^ (-(1 / 2)))
